tabs.title: Overview
paragraphs: Tailspin Toys develops online games. The operations team manages about 40 VMs (virtual machines) and several web apps in the subscription sub-games.

tabs.title: Existing environment
paragraphs: - Monthly costs of sub-games are about $8,000.
- Every resource group has a CostCenter tag, but most resources in the groups have none.
- The Log Analytics workspace law-ops collects platform logs. The VMs run Windows Server and send no data from inside the operating system.
- The VM vm-game1 hosts the game lobby. The team performs maintenance every Sunday from 01:00 to 03:00.

tabs.title: Requirements
paragraphs: - The finance team must receive an email when the forecasted monthly cost of sub-games exceeds $10,000. No resource may be stopped because of cost.
- Every resource, including existing ones, must have the CostCenter tag of its resource group.
- Windows event logs and performance counters of all VMs must be collected in law-ops.
- The team must be notified when vm-game1 uses more than 85% CPU (central processing unit) for 15 minutes, except during the maintenance window. Alert rules must stay enabled.
- Management operations must be kept for two years for audits.
- Resources in the resource group rg-games must be protected from accidental deletion, but administrators must still be able to change them.

questions.prompt: What should you create to meet the cost requirement?
options: A policy assignment with the deny effect
A budget on sub-games with a forecasted cost alert at 100% of $10,000 and the finance email address
questions.explanation: Budget memberi peringatan saat biaya actual atau forecast melewati threshold, tanpa menghentikan resource. Deny dan Read-only lock memblokir perubahan, bukan memberi peringatan biaya.

questions.prompt: Which two actions should you perform to apply the CostCenter tags? Choose two.
options: Add the tag again to every resource group so that resources inherit it
Assign the built-in policy Inherit a tag from the resource group if missing
Apply a Read-only lock to every resource group
Create a remediation task for the existing resources
questions.explanation: Resource tidak mewarisi tag dari resource group. Policy bawaan itu menambahkan tag ke resource baru atau yang diubah, dan remediation task memperbaiki resource lama.

questions.prompt: What should you use to collect the Windows event logs and performance counters?
options: A diagnostic setting on each VM (virtual machine)
Azure Monitor Agent with a data collection rule that sends the data to law-ops
questions.explanation: Data dari dalam OS (operating system) butuh Azure Monitor Agent dan data collection rule. Host metrics dan activity log tidak berisi event log Windows.

questions.prompt: How should you stop the CPU (central processing unit) notifications during the maintenance window?
options: Disable the alert rule every Sunday
Remove the email address from the action group every Sunday
Increase the aggregation granularity of the alert rule
Create an alert processing rule that suppresses notifications every Sunday from 01:00 to 03:00
questions.explanation: Alert processing rule berulang bisa menekan notifikasi pada jadwal tertentu tanpa mematikan alert rule, dan alert yang ditekan tetap tercatat.

questions.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
questions.scenario: You review the audit and protection requirements.

statements.text: Without any configuration, the activity log keeps management operations for two years.
A diagnostic setting can send the activity log to a Log Analytics workspace or a storage account.
A Delete lock on rg-games still lets administrators resize its VMs (virtual machines).

questions.explanation: Activity log hanya disimpan 90 hari; untuk dua tahun, kirim lewat diagnostic setting. Delete lock memblokir hapus, tapi tetap mengizinkan perubahan.
